newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria set to cancel December bond auction-OKB.
newsitem.headline: Austria set to cancel December bond auction-OKB.

text.p: Austria's federal financing agency is set to cancel a bond auction originally planned for December 3, the Austrian Kontrollbank (OKB), which handles the government's bond issues, said on Thursday.
"All we know is that the issue has been cancelled because of recent developments," an OKB spokeswoman told Reuters. No details of the planned tender had been announced.
Sources at the government's financing agency said the issue had been cancelled because there was no need for further bond issues this year.

The Austrian government usually tenders new bond issues about every six weeks. In its latest tender, the governement sold 15 billion schillings in a new 5.875 percent 9.7-year bond at the end of October.
